notes.title: The major update of "Fight Landlord Girl" is coming! 8 heroines are all over!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35622075/7bb09dbcab4cb71cf0884fae74fcb4d3dda92eb1.png
 First of all, thank you all for your support! From its release to the present, tens of thousands of players have purchased and experienced this game.
There is a lot of attention and support, and a lot of feedback and suggestions. Of course, I can't forget the criticism and improvement of the game by many people.
We have always been committed to creating the best gaming experience with few resources. (The total development funding is only 150,000)
Although there are a lot of regrets, I can tell you with satisfaction that starting from today, the story chapters of this single-player game have all ended. The story and ending of the 8 heroine chapters have come to an end. At the same time, this game also supports card dropping!

There may be many small partners looking forward to the DLC content in the future, but unfortunately, due to a loss of 100,000, we cannot plan to produce additional content for the game. (Can be considered after returning to the book)
(In fact, the update was reluctantly developed. For this reason, I borrowed 30,000 yuan from the bank to successfully develop it.)
Later, for the tasks of this game, AI will be deeply optimized and BUG corrected.

Sounds like bad news in summary? What about the online mode content mentioned before?
This question cannot be avoided and needs to be responded to. It is very important for the development situation to stop the loss in time, but the development team has a clear attitude towards the game and will never make the project unfinished!
Borrowing money also requires the development of all limited game content. So the content of the online mode, you can tell everyone responsibly, we will continue to develop it! But unfortunately, the current program cannot continue to be produced, and we have to change the development engine to develop, so the content of the online mode will be launched in the new store! The store is now open, and the game is free to play. We welcome everyone to follow the game wish list and keep abreast of the development process of the game.

 The following is the content of this game update:
1. The seventh chapter of the new character Xue Wen is officially launched. Including new stories, CG, dubbing, store skins and more.
2. The eighth chapter of the new role Bauhinia is officially launched. Including new stories, CG, dubbing, store skins and more.
3. The final chapter is officially launched, including the final ending of the 8 female lead lines.
4. Optimized and improved some logic problems of AI. (Become smarter)
5. Amended the content of some known bugs.
6. Officially support card background drop!
Note: If the game version number is not 1.2.0.0, please update the latest version as soon as possible. Please install version 7.18 for the social security patch. If the game has an old patch other than the version installed, please delete all folders under json and verify the version file again. If it is not deleted, it may affect the operation of the game and cause problems such as stuck screen, flashing back and black screen.


Finally, our new work "Comrade Chuan Jianguo Wants to Be Re-elected" was officially released today!
This is a very interesting simulated role-playing game. Welcome all the big players who have money to hold a money market, and some people hold one to enter!
